DEWALT DCC018N-XJ 18V XR compact high performance inflator provides fast, accurate inflation for tyres and various inflatables, ideal for both jobsite and leisure use. Features a high-pressure hose, able to inflate car tyres in approximately 400 seconds, and a digital gauge with high-pressure auto shut-off which enables precise PSI presets and automatic stop to prevent over-inflation. An integrated LED light improves visibility in low-light conditions. Compact and lightweight design with on-board accessory storage for convenience. Compatible with all Dewalt 18V XR Li-Ion batteries (sold separately).
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
